anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck issues.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating it might be inactive or misconfigured.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review AI system configuration and ensure it is properly integrated and functioning to leverage its capabilities.
Evaluate trading strategies and system settings to ensure trades are being executed as expected.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the cause, such as optimizing processes or scaling resources.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect the platform's ability to process trades efficiently.

recommendations.action: Verify the AI system's configuration and logs to ensure it is active and correctly processing data.
